integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands in a dim room, framed from the waist up, one hand resting on the pages of an open book in <Subject 1>'s hands, which is covered in a fine honeycomb of hexagons. The camera pushes in at slow speed. The pattern starts to creep off it and onto the skin of the hand, a clean advancing edge moving a few centimetres at a time, and wherever it passes the skin simply becomes a fine honeycomb of hexagons, flat and exact, as though printed from the inside. <Subject 1> pulls the hand away, but the pattern keeps travelling up the wrist, across the forearm and over the shoulder, its edge sharp against the untouched skin. It reaches the neck and climbs along the jaw. <Subject 1> touches the changed skin and it feels exactly like skin. In the final moment the whole pattern begins to move, slowly turning across the body.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, uneasy breathing, a dry whispering sound like ink spreading across paper, and the rustle of fabric.
